name: Мирзо Турсунзода (ноҳияи Шаҳринав) (Октябр)
basis: the census page puts this settlement in the districts of republican subordination around Dushanbe; the GeoNames Oktyabr chosen on rank alone lies by Isfara in Sughd, and no place of that name is in the region

name: Ремівка
basis: the census page puts it in Donetsk oblast among the mining towns of the east; the GeoNames Remivka chosen on rank alone lies at the oblast's western edge and could not be confirmed

name: Рудничне
basis: the census page puts it in Luhansk oblast; the GeoNames Rudnychne chosen on rank alone lies in Donetsk oblast

name: Юріївка (Юр'ївка)
basis: the census page puts it in Luhansk oblast; the GeoNames Yuriyivka chosen on rank alone lies on the Azov coast, over 150 km away

name: Кунград
basis: Kungrad (Qo'ng'irot) lies in Karakalpakstan near the Aral Sea; the only GeoNames place of that Cyrillic name lies near Samarkand, about 800 km away
